cis.heading: CIS: who has an assistant, who acts

azerbaijan.note: A wallet chat for payments, no shop assistant.

kazakhstan.note: Kaspi’s Kasper (pilot) recommends, does not buy. Nothing at Halyk or Freedom.

russia.note: Ozon and Wildberries only advise. Only Yandex acts, through its own closed protocol.

uzbekistan.note: None at Uzum. Wildberries’ assistant, availability unclear.

every-store-gets-its.text: The Storefront MCP server lets an agent search the catalog, read product details and store policies, build and edit a cart, and hand the shopper a checkout link. Shopify now steers new integrations to its Universal Commerce Protocol endpoint.
every-store-gets-its.title: Every store gets its own MCP endpoint

hubspot-remote-mcp-server.text: Read and write access over OAuth 2.1: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, plus calls, meetings, notes and tasks. Every action respects the user’s own permissions.
hubspot-remote-mcp-server.title: HubSpot remote MCP server is generally available

mcp-moves-to-the.text: Anthropic donates the protocol to the Agentic AI Foundation, co-founded with Block and OpenAI and backed by Google, Microsoft, AWS and Cloudflare. Supported by ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor and VS Code.
mcp-moves-to-the.title: MCP moves to the Linux Foundation

salesforce-hosted-mcp-servers.text: A Salesforce-managed endpoint exposes an org’s data, flows, Apex actions and queries to any MCP-compatible client, Enterprise Edition and above.
salesforce-hosted-mcp-servers.title: Salesforce hosted MCP servers are generally available

typesafe-launches-jev-the.text: A model for decisions, not text: the app passes state and typed questions, Jev answers with probabilities in 70–500 ms (vendor figures). System 1 in Kahneman’s sense: a quick reflex beside slow reasoning models. Pleiades’ decision agent speaks the same system_one protocol.
typesafe-launches-jev-the.title: TypeSafe launches Jev, the first System One model

lead: Through MCP, an AI agent can use a product the way a person does: put an item in the cart, buy it, create a deal, log a call. This is how the big platforms got there.
